tools.name: business_day
tools.description: Whether a date is a business day in a country (holiday/weekend/make-up workday aware), plus the previous and next business day. Price: $0.001 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

tools.name: business_days_add
tools.description: Date that is N business days after (or before, if negative) a start date in a country. Typical use: T+2 settlement, SLA and filing deadlines. Price: $0.002 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

tools.name: business_days_count
tools.description: Number of business days in [start, end] inclusive (max 3 years), with the holidays that fell on weekdays. Price: $0.002 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

tools.name: holidays
tools.description: All national public holidays for a country and year, with weekend definition and official weekend make-up workdays. Price: $0.002 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).
